summary: The dark theme and RTL layout are mostly intact, but bidirectional text rendering issues and mirrored media controls introduce minor UI defects.

issues.title: Inverted playback skip controls
issues.description: Playback skip icons around the main action button are reversed due to unhandled RTL mirroring.
issues.evidence: The skip forward icon appears on the left of play, while skip backward appears on the right.
issues.suggestion: Preserve standard media control orientations under RTL layouts.

issues.title: Bidi punctuation displacement on timeline markers
issues.description: RTL direction causes hyphens on numeric time markers to jump positions.
issues.evidence: Timeline labels render as '30s-', '60s-', and '90s-' instead of '-30s', '-60s', '-90s'.
issues.suggestion: Wrap numeric timeline scale values in directional isolation tags.
